name: Alessandra Bellini
bio:
Alessandra Bellini didn't grow up around the roar of engines, but rather the sizzle of pans and the fragrant aroma of her family's trattoria in Modena. Her journey into motorsport began unexpectedly when a local racing team, impressed by her family's food, hired them to cater their events. Alessandra quickly realized that keeping a hungry team fueled was just as crucial as keeping the cars fueled. 

She prides herself on providing high-quality, nutritious meals that boost team morale and performance. Alessandra is known for her meticulous planning and unwavering standards. She insists on sourcing the freshest local ingredients and creating menus tailored to the specific dietary needs and preferences of each team member. She believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and she's determined to prove it, one delicious meal at a time.

Her demanding nature stems from a deep-seated belief in excellence and a passion for providing the best possible service. While some might find her strict, her dedication to quality is undeniable, and her culinary creations consistently receive rave reviews from even the most discerning palates in the paddock. Alessandra brings a touch of Italian flair and uncompromising standards to ROWE Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, styled in loose waves with a slight side part.
physical.description: Alessandra is a stout woman with a warm smile and expressive eyes, often seen wearing a chef's apron even outside of the kitchen.

quirks: Insists on personally tasting every dish before it's served, even if she didn't cook it.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and menu ideas.
Refers to the drivers as 'her bambini' and secretly worries if they are eating enough vegetables.
